findings.explanation: Splunkbase 4022 is 'Technical Addon for the Metricator application for Nmon (HEC)' (TA-metricator-hec-for-nmon), not a Cisco ACI add-on. The same wrong ID is repeated in dataSources, implementation, detailedImplementation and references.
findings.suggested_fix: Name the real ACI collector: Cisco DC Networking (Splunkbase 7777, cisco_dc_networking_app_for_splunk), which collects ACI via API, or the deprecated Cisco ACI Add-on (Splunkbase 1897, TA_cisco-ACI). Remove every '4022' reference.

findings.explanation: F1394 is ethpm-if-port-down-fabric (a leaf-to-spine fabric port is physically down). F2301 is fltAnalyticsRsProfAttResolveFail (an analytics relation that does not resolve). Neither one signals contract deny pressure or shadow-EPG deployment failure. The same mislabelling appears in dataSources and in the 'Understanding this SPL' text.
findings.quote: Poll `faultInst` filtered to at least **F1394** (policy enforcement pressure) and **F2301** (binding or deployment failures)
findings.suggested_fix: Replace these with fault codes that are actually tied to contract or zoning-rule deployment (look them up in the APIC System Messages Reference), or drop the fault lane. If F1394 is kept, describe it as fabric-link down context.

findings.explanation: actrlRuleHit5min is a leaf-local stats child. Its DN looks like sys/actrl/scope-<id>/rule-<id>-s-<pcTag>-d-<pcTag>-f-<flt>/CDactrlRuleHit5min, and its attributes are ingrPktsCum/egrPktsCum/ingrPktsLast/egrPktsLast. There is no tn-/brc-/subj- segment and no actEntry/sClass/dClass attribute. sPcTag/dPcTag/fltId/action belong to the parent actrlRule.
findings.suggested_fix: Document the real attributes. Explain that you get a contract name by joining actrlRule (sPcTag, dPcTag, fltId, scopeId) to vzBrCP/fvEPg through pcTag and VRF scope lookups, not by parsing the rule DN.

findings.explanation: ACL log MOs use srcIp, dstIp, protocol, srcPort, dstPort, srcPcTag, dstPcTag and srcEpgName/dstEpgName. Their DNs are topology/pod-N/node-N/ndbgs/acllog/tn-<tenant>/ctx-<vrf>/..., not actrlRule DNs. There is also no action attribute, because the class name itself encodes drop or permit.
findings.suggested_fix: Use the documented attribute names, and state that the collector must stamp action from the class name (acllogDrop* vs acllogPermit*). Note that permit logging needs EX/FX or later leaves.

findings.explanation: The SPL groups stats by intersite_hint and then tests values(intersite_hint) for 'orch_meta'. So risk_shadow_gap can only fire on rows made up entirely of cisco:aci:multisite events. Deny counters and ACL drops land in different rows. The search never correlates an NDO deploy with denies, so the prose describes a correlation the search does not perform.
findings.quote: **`risk_shadow_gap`** surfaces successful **NDO** deploy keywords coinciding with rising denies
findings.suggested_fix: Describe what the SPL actually computes, or flag to SPL owners that the grouping must drop intersite_hint before the correlation can work.

findings.explanation: Contract rule hit statistics (actrlRuleHit5min) are collected per zoning rule on the leaf. I could not confirm that vzSubj has a statsEnabled attribute or that it gates these counters. The APIC GUI path 'Contracts → {contract} → Subjects → Statistics' is also unverified.
findings.suggested_fix: Check the APIC MIM for vzSubj attributes and the 6.x GUI navigation, and state the real prerequisite: deny/permit logging is set with the 'log' directive on subject filters.

findings.explanation: The Multi-Site white paper and REST API guide entries point at generic cisco.com root paths, so a reader cannot follow them.
findings.suggested_fix: Link the specific ACI Multi-Site Architecture white paper, the APIC REST API Configuration Guide, and the APIC Security Configuration Guide ACL logging page.

findings.explanation: The UC is marked verified by an agent reviewer while it carries a wrong Splunkbase ID, mislabelled fault codes and invented MO attributes, so there is no evidence of SME sign-off.
findings.suggested_fix: Downgrade status until a human SME validates against a live APIC.

findings.explanation: implementation and detailedImplementation use aci_maint_intersite.csv for suppression, while knownFalsePositives names a different register, so readers are told two different suppression mechanisms.
findings.quote: schedule **`aci_uc1836_intersite_contract_deny_core`** every five minutes with **`aci_maint_intersite.csv`** suppression
findings.suggested_fix: Pick one suppression lookup and use it everywhere.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: tenant_tag/contract_tag/subject_tag are extracted from tn-/brc-/subj- DN segments. actrlRuleHit5min DNs (sys/actrl/scope-.../rule-...) and acllog DNs (no brc-/subj-) do not contain them. contract_path then evaluates to null, and stats BY contract_path discards those events, so the stats and flow lanes cannot produce rows. In addition, actEntry/ingrPkts do not exist on actrlRuleHit5min (they are ingrPktsCum etc.), so stats_penalty is always 0.

Hard-coded fault codes F1394 (fabric port down) and F2301 (analytics relation resolve failure) are unrelated to contract enforcement. Any F1394 fabric-link fault would set risk_fault_pair=1 and alert, provided its row survives the null contract_path grouping.

Because stats is grouped BY intersite_hint, values(intersite_hint) is always a single value equal to the group key. risk_shadow_gap therefore only evaluates multisite-only rows and never correlates NDO deploys with denies. The acl_log lane filters on an action field that ACI acllog MOs do not carry.

summary: An ambitious multi-site contract-deny correlation built on wrong product facts. Splunkbase 4022 is the wrong add-on, F1394 and F2301 are not contract or shadow-EPG faults, and the actrlRuleHit5min and acllog field names and DN shapes are invented. As a result the tenant/contract DN parsing the SPL relies on cannot work.
